method: git grep across docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.control.yml, docker-compose.remote-dev.yml, docker-compose.exec.yml and services/**/*.py (excluding *_test.py/tests/) for PANTHEON_S3_*, PANTHEON_ARTIFACT_BUCKET, boto3, botocore, and an S3 client construction. Read-only; no secret values were read and no hosted system was mutated.

control_stack.note: client tag diverges from main_stack (pinned digest vs floating latest); both point at the same archived/unmaintained upstream per docs/reviews/2026-09-06-system-simplification/oss-findings.md line 34.

posture_only_readers_of_object_store_env.behavior: validate_persistence_posture() only checks that all four keys are non-empty strings when PANTHEON_PERSISTENCE_POSTURE/PANTHEON_ENV is stage/staging/prod. It never opens a network connection, never constructs an S3/GCS client, and never reads or writes an object.
posture_only_readers_of_object_store_env.docstring_confirmation: "The check is intentionally configuration-only ... It does not open database or object-store connections."

posture_only_readers_of_object_store_env.behavior: validate_source_search_posture() performs the same presence-only check for source-ingest/search staging/prod posture; no object I/O.

code_level_finding.conclusion: Every one of the 17 (main) / 12 (control) declared 'consumers' above only forwards or requires the four PANTHEON_S3_* env vars for a staging/prod posture gate. No service in services/**/*.py constructs a boto3/S3 client or performs an S3 GET/PUT against MinIO. The MinIO server + minio-init glue in both Compose files currently has zero real object read/write consumers and holds zero real objects beyond the empty 'pantheon-artifacts' bucket minio-init creates at boot.

real_object_store_consumer.behavior: prepare_inline_attachment()/store_inline_attachment() upload management-AI chat attachments to `gs://<bucket>/management-ai-attachments/<session>/<turn>/<id>-<filename>` via storage.Client().bucket(...).blob(...).upload_from_string(...); read() downloads the same object by its recorded storageUrl/objectName. When PANTHEON_MGMT_AI_ATTACH_BUCKET is unset it falls back to a local filesystem path (dev/local), never to MinIO/S3.
real_object_store_consumer.existing_isolated_proof: services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_mgmt_ai_persistence_2026_06_03.py::test_management_ai_attachment_store_uses_gcs_bucket_metadata (fake-bucket round trip of content, size, content-type, filename)
real_object_store_consumer.note: This is the only place in the repository where real object bytes are written to and read back from an external object-store API. It already uses GCS, not MinIO/S3, and it is unrelated to the PANTHEON_S3_* variables above.

retention_legal_hold_versioning_encrypti.finding: No service (MinIO-wired or GCS-wired) declares a retention policy, legal-hold flag, bucket versioning, server-side-encryption key, or per-tenant bucket/prefix partition anywhere in docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.control.yml, or services/control-plane/bff/management_ai_store.py. The one real consumer partitions objects by session_id/turn_id path prefix only, inside a single shared bucket/prefix.
retention_legal_hold_versioning_encrypti.implication: There is no existing retention/legal-hold/versioning/tenant-isolation contract to preserve or migrate; the storage-topology-decision only needs to keep object durability and the existing prefix-based identity scheme.

existing_data_volumes.minio_data_docker_volume: declared (minio-data) in both docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.control.yml, but no committed evidence of populated hosted content was found or read; this task did not connect to a hosted MinIO instance or read its data.
existing_data_volumes.gcs_bucket: PANTHEON_MGMT_AI_ATTACH_BUCKET is unset by default in both compose files (empty string), so the default posture for both stacks is the local-filesystem fallback, not a populated GCS bucket.

licensing_and_restore_ownership.minio_server: AGPLv3 community distribution; per docs/reviews/2026-09-06-system-simplification/oss-findings.md line 34 the upstream community repository was archived 2026-04-25 and is no longer maintained (source-only distribution going forward); the currently pinned digest and the two divergent `mc` client tags (RELEASE.2024-01-16T16-06-34Z vs latest) cannot be refreshed against a maintained upstream release.
licensing_and_restore_ownership.google_cloud_storage_client: Apache-2.0 licensed Python client (google-cloud-storage), backed by the managed Google Cloud Storage service under Google's standard GCP terms; restore/versioning/retention are GCS platform features configured on the bucket, not something Pantheon has to operate.
licensing_and_restore_ownership.restore_ownership_today: docs/deployment/vm-dev-staging-prod-management-plan.md §11.3 declares a general per-release restore-rehearsal and production-shaped restore-drill policy, and lists MinIO alongside Postgres/NATS among stateful backends covered by VM/data-disk backup, but neither it nor docs/deployment/evidence/ops-vm-env-phase0-20260825/service-inventory.md documents a MinIO-specific object-level restore/versioning procedure; restore ownership for MinIO objects today is the same generic VM-disk-snapshot policy as every other stateful backend, not a bucket-specific runbook.
